case_title: Dinesh Tiwari v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
trial_court_outcome: Charged for murder and other offences
neutral_facts: The accused, along with two other individuals, was charged with the murder of the victim. The complainant lodged an FIR against the accused and the other co-accused for the offence. The investigating agency submitted a charge sheet against the co-accused for the murder and other offences, but no charge sheet was submitted against the accused for the murder. The case was committed to the Sessions Court, which framed a charge against the accused for the murder, in addition to other charges. The accused challenged the framing of the charge by filing a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., which was dismissed by the High Court. The accused appealed against the High Court's decision.
